facts.fact: The Federation of Enterprises of Congo says it took part on 23-24 July 2026 in the technical validation workshop of the national AI strategy (SNIA-RDC) and its roadmap to 2030, organised by the Ministry of Digital Economy with World Bank support.

facts.fact: At a national workshop on 21-22 July 2026 organised by the Ministry of Digital Economy with World Bank support, participants validated, subject to some amendments, the Sector Policy of the Digital Economy 2026-2030 (PSEN), as the Federation of Enterprises of Congo reports.
The Sector Policy of the Digital Economy is for 2026-2030, per the Federation of Enterprises of Congo.

The Federation of Enterprises of Congo's digital committee says it took part in the Ministry of Digital Economy's national validation workshop of the Sector Policy of the Digital Economy 2026-2030 on 21-22 July 2026, and in the technical validation workshop of the national AI strategy on 23-24 July 2026.
